description: Defines the pucch_resource_manager class responsible for managing PUCCH resources in a cellular network, including resource reservation, release, and tracking for UEs, with associated helper classes and data structures.

classes.name: pucch_resource_manager
classes.description: Manages cell allocation of PUCCH resources across UEs, including reservation, release, and tracking.

classes.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard
classes.description: RAII helper class for managing temporary reservations of PUCCH resources for a UE.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Resets all resources to 'unused' at a given slot.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the resource manager, likely cleaning up or halting operations.

methods.name: reserve_harq_common_resource
methods.description: Reserves a common PUCCH HARQ resource if available.

methods.name: release_harq_common_resource
methods.description: Releases a previously reserved common PUCCH HARQ resource.

methods.name: ue_reservation_guard::reserve_harq_set_0_resource_next_available
methods.description: Reserves the next available PUCCH resource in set 0 for a UE.

methods.name: ue_reservation_guard::reserve_harq_set_1_resource_next_available
methods.description: Reserves the next available PUCCH resource in set 1 for a UE.

methods.name: peek_sr_resource
methods.description: Peeks at the configured SR PUCCH resource without reserving.

methods.name: peek_csi_resource
methods.description: Peeks at the configured CSI PUCCH resource without reserving.

methods.name: release_harq_set_0_resource
methods.description: Releases a HARQ set 0 resource for a UE.

methods.name: release_harq_set_1_resource
methods.description: Releases a HARQ set 1 resource for a UE.

methods.name: release_sr_resource
methods.description: Releases the SR PUCCH resource for a UE.

methods.name: release_csi_resource
methods.description: Releases the CSI PUCCH resource for a UE.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits all reservations made in the current guard scope.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Rolls back all reservations made in the current guard scope.
